newsitem.title: USA: Stone & Youngberg names associate to muni team.
newsitem.headline: Stone & Youngberg names associate to muni team.

text.p: Stone & Youngberg LLC said Paul Whitaker has joined the firm as an associate responsible for managing workouts of distressed real estate bond financings.

Whitaker joined Stone & Youngberg from San Diego, where he was program manager for special district administration. He headed the workout of the $22 million First San Diego River Improvement Project, which lapsed into default in September 1995.
Stone & Youngberg said Whitaker would be a lead member of its workout team, which is working out troubled land-secured bond issues in a dozen California communities.
Stone & Youngberg specializes in public finance and is a leader in municipal land-backed bond financings.
